finding.headline: "The Mask-of-Pregnancy Mum"
finding.problem: "I have brown patches like a mask. People ask if I'm ill. I stopped taking pictures. Bleaching creams scare me because I'm breastfeeding."
finding.person: 31-yr-old Nigerian mum, 3 months postpartum, dark melasma patches on cheeks; melanin-rich skin makes it obvious.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone → "Glow Back Safely: Postpartum Skincare for Melanin-Rich Skin (Breastfeeding-Safe)"". Verdict: PASSES (5/5) —.
